insights.growth: $49.4K/30d, $19.67 AOV, 2.56% CR; affiliate-led with 60% organic base

opportunities.opportunity: Implement upsell/cross-sell bundles and post-purchase offers to lift AOV from $19.67 toward $25+
Redesign top landing pages to reduce 45% bounce rate and improve CR from 2.56% to 3.2%+
Expand affiliate program with tiered commissions and recruit 20+ new partners to diversify beyond current top source

risks.risk: Over-dependence on affiliate channel as top revenue source creates concentration risk if key partners underperform
risks.mitigation: Grow organic and paid channels to reduce affiliate share below 50% of revenue within 90 days

risks.risk: 45% bounce rate signals poor landing page relevance or UX friction, capping conversion potential
risks.mitigation: Run A/B tests on hero sections, CTAs, and page load speed; target bounce rate below 35%

insights.summary: Revenue is stable at $49.4K/30d with a $0.168 RPV. The 60% organic traffic base is healthy, but low AOV ($19.67) and 45% bounce rate are the primary growth constraints. Prioritize AOV uplift via bundling and landing page optimization to unlock $40K+ in incremental monthly revenue. Diversify away from affiliate concentration to reduce channel risk.
